issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a no-argument method messageOnMilk() that returns a String (and Main calls m.messageOnMilk() with no arguments), but the solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) (and Goat/Seal implement messageOnMilk(double)). This parameter mismatch will confuse students about the correct method signature and can cause compilation or integration errors if they follow the problem/template (no-arg) or the solution (with double).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the messageOnMilk signature consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to define Milkable.messageOnMilk() with no parameters and update Goat/Seal to implement messageOnMilk() returning the specified string format (e.g. "Seal Clarabelle is milked"), or (B) update the problem statement and template to require a double volume parameter and adjust the example usages and expected return format accordingly. Prefer option A to match the current problem description and template usage.
